blocks.text: A **dot product** multiplies two vectors entry by entry and adds the results. For $u, v \in \mathbb{R}^d$: $u \cdot v = \sum_{k=1}^{d} u_k v_k$. The result is one number. It is large when the vectors point in a similar direction.
If $A$ has shape $(n, d)$ and $B$ has shape $(d, m)$, then $AB$ has shape $(n, m)$. The inner sizes must match. Entry $(i, j)$ of $AB$ is the dot product of row $i$ of $A$ with column $j$ of $B$.
In attention, scores are `Q @ K.T`. The transpose turns the rows of `K` into columns. Without it the inner sizes do not match.
